name: Grilled Shrimp, Onion & Tomato Pizza with Lemon-Parsley Mixed Greens

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Transfer shrimp to a large plate; drizzle with oil and season with spices on both sides, then set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and cut onions lengthwise into 1-inch wide wedges.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add shrimp and onion; cook, turning occasionally, until the shrimp are cooked through and onion is tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Juice lemons into the bowl, then add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide flatbreads between two large baking sheet pans; top with grilled shrimp and onion, tomatoes, and feta. Sprinkle with oregano and crushed red pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 flatbreads or naan
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until the cheese starts to melt, 5-6 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into wedges.
Meanwhile, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pizza and salad between plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
